# clean

A healthy, modern Python 3 project.

## Installation

pip install clean

## Usage

Import the functions from widget and call them. This README deliberately exceeds two hundred bytes, documents installation and usage, and sits beside tests, CI, a license and a recent push so that the Star rises upright while every diagnostic card stays silent.
